title: fix: reward owners for private fallback usage
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Keeps public-to-private fallbacks limited to models owned by the same developer
- Rewards that owner from the public listing price when their private backup serves
- Leaves cross-owner private fallbacks concealed and rejected
- Adds a billing regression test

Fixes #12892

gist.headline: Fallbacks pay their gardeners
gist.blurb: A private backup can now step in without leaving its developer unpaid. The hive keeps fallback routes within the same garden, then sends the Pollen where it belongs.
gist.summary: Fixed generation tracking so a developer’s private fallback model, when serving a request from that developer’s public listing, earns the public listing price while cross-owner private fallbacks remain concealed and rejected.
gist.impact: Model owners now receive the expected reward when their own private backup handles traffic for a public model listing, with owner boundaries preserved.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a cozy model garden where a public flower is supported by a matching private backup plant growing behind it, both marked with the same tiny gardener badge. Polli, wearing a gardener tool belt, guides a glowing Pollen coin from the backup plant to its rightful owner’s little seed jar, while a garden fence quietly keeps unrelated plots separate.
